{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.72

|gr1= Math - Vectors
|gr2= Render Time Scope

|descr= Converts vector direction from world to model space in [[Simulation vs Render Time Scope|render time scope]].
{{Feature|important|For [[setObjectScale|scaled objects]], the resulting vector's [[vectorMagnitude|magnitude]] will be [[vectorMultiply|divided]] by the object scale.}}

|s1= object [[vectorWorldToModelVisual]] worldDir

|p1= object: [[Object]]

|p2= worldDir: [[Vector3D]] - vector direction in world space in format [x,y,z]

|r1= [[Vector3D]] - vector direction in model space in format [x,y,z]

|x1= Convert world space vector [0,-10,4] to model space of object _airplane:
<sqf>private _vector = _airplane vectorWorldToModelVisual [0,-10,4];</sqf>

|seealso= [[addForce]] [[worldToModelVisual]] [[addTorque]] [[vectorModelToWorld]] [[vectorModelToWorldVisual]] [[vectorWorldToModel]]
}}
